# Setup and installation

Rcpp wrappers for the CNCpp `Point`, `Block`, `Machine`, and `Program` classes.

## On Windows/WSL or on Linux

You need to install R and some base packages on the linux OS:

```sh
sudo apt update
sudo apt install r-base r-core 
```

## On MacOS

You need a working installation of R (<https://www.r-project.org/>).

## Installation

Install from the **repository root** after CMake has fetched the C++ dependencies:

```sh
cmake -B build -G Ninja
R CMD INSTALL R
```

## Usage

Use the R interpreter:

* If you are on macOS or on Linux, you can use RStudio
* If you are on Windows/WSL, you cannot use the RStudio installed on the Windows side, because you need an R interpreter running in the Linux WSL environment.

Example:

```r
library(cncppr)

p <- Point(1, 2, 3)
point_length(p)

b0 <- Block("N1 G00 X0 Y0 Z0")
block_parse(b0)

b1 <- Block("N2 G01 X100 Y100 Z0 F1000", b0)
block_parse(b1)

block_summary(b1)
head(block_walk(b1))
```
